Attributes use [0..1] for optional values and [0..*] for lists. {PK}/{UQ} are schema-key constraints. Enforced relations and scalar-ID mappings are listed below; cross-service IDs are not foreign keys. UNIQUE(seriesId,episodeNumber) orders episodes. ViewSession PK is (userId,reelId,playbackSessionId). ViewEvent UNIQUE(userId,reelId,playbackSessionId,sequence). Outbox aggregate and playback-session correlation links have no declared FK. series: seriesId; nullable; onDelete SetNull (declared SQL FK); reel: reelId; Cascade delete (declared SQL FK); reel: reelId; Cascade delete (declared SQL FK); reel: reelId; Cascade delete (declared SQL FK); reel: reelId; Cascade delete (declared SQL FK); aggregate: aggregateId when aggregateType=REEL (logical) (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); playback session: userId + reelId + playbackSessionId correlation (scalar-ID association; no declared FK) Operational upload/media-attempt lease rows are Content-owned; their publishIntentId/mediaKey and reelId/attemptId links are logical correlations, not declared Prisma FKs."><root><mxCell id="0" style="fontFamily=Arial;" value="" /><mxCell id="1" width="2425.968" height="45" /></mxCell><mxCell id="notes" value="UNIQUE(userId, publishIntentId): one logical Reel per owner / publish action.<br>Fingerprint rejects conflicting intent reuse; different intent permits the same source video.<br>Upload adoption uses owner + publishIntentId + mediaKey. div.div:
UNIQUE(userId, publishIntentId): one logical Reel per owner / publish action.
Fingerprint rejects conflicting intent reuse; different intent permits the same source video.
Upload adoption uses owner + publishIntentId + mediaKey. Attempt leases correlate by reelId / attemptId.
These lease correlations are logical scalar IDs, not declared foreign keys.
Series deletion sets the optional Reel link to null; declared Reel references cascade. Outbox/session links are logical.
